title: upgrade: add upgrade/migration/rollback tooling with version pinning, backups, and downgrade guards
author: Aisha Raman
description: Motivation: Private deployments need safer, observable upgrades and a supported rollback path. This PR implements a coordinated upgrade/migration toolchain across the private installer, Helm charts, and Terraform modules: version pinning for critical components, automated pre-upgrade backups, schema migration runner with idempotency and dry-run, and explicit downgrade guards that block unsafe rollbacks. The goal is to make upgrades reversible where possible and to fail-fast when downgrades would risk data loss. Scope: - redwood-private-installer: new `redwood-installer upgrade` and `redwood-installer rollback` subcommands, backup orchestration hooks, migration registry, and downgrade guard checks. - redwood-helm-charts: values/templating changes to support pinned images and migration initContainers. - redwood-terraform: add module outputs/inputs for snapshot configuration and a migration lock resource. - docs: upgrade workflow, troubleshooting, and runbook. Design highlights: - Version pinning: cluster-level `redwood.installer.lockedVersions` persisted in the installer control state (checked into OperatorConfig CRD) so upgrades use deterministic artifacts. Downgrades require an explicit `--allow-downgrade` flag plus a validated snapshot. - Backup/restore: installer integrates with the customer-configured snapshot provider (S3-compatible or CSI hooks). Pre-upgrade step creates a named snapshot and records metadata (timestamp, manifest, schema_version). - Schema migrations: implement a migration registry with strict ordering and idempotency keys. The migration runner supports `--dry-run` and `--rollback-only` markers for individual migrations. - Downgrade guards: before applying a downgrade the installer validates schema compatibility and the presence of a snapshot that predates the target version. If incompatible migrations are detected the rollback is blocked and the operator receives an actionable error. - Rollback strategy: three-tier rollback (fast rollback with cached snapshots, controlled rollback using restored DB + replay, emergency manual process). This PR implements the tooling and the automated fast rollback path. Changes included: - CLI: commands and flags, preflight checks. - Installer operator: new CRD fields and controller changes to orchestrate snapshots and migrations. - Helm charts: migration initContainers, version pin values, and probes to gate traffic until migrations finish. - Terraform: new migration_lock resource and snapshot configuration variables. - Tests: unit tests for migration registry, e2e smoke test in perf-canary pipeline, and upgrade/rollback integration test. Backwards compatibility: installer will continue supporting clusters without migration metadata but will default to safer (no-downgrade) behavior. Rollout: this is gated by a feature flag `enable_migration_tooling` and a gradual rollout across Dedicated and Private installs. See release_notes for admin-facing notes.

release_notes: Add upgrade/rollback tooling for Private installs: new CLI commands and operator orchestration.
Pre-upgrade backups: snapshots are taken automatically before migrations run.
Schema migration registry: ordered, idempotent migrations with dry-run support.
Downgrade guards: downgrades blocked unless explicit snapshot and --allow-downgrade flag provided.
Feature flagged: enable_migration_tooling (default: off for existing clusters).
